_comment: #876 W1/W2: the nightly in-environment checks tools/nightly_verdicts.py bounds, and how often each ticks. The names are exactly what the data engine's lanes can record in mart.nightly_verdicts (their NIGHTLY_VERDICTS): libs/runtime/tests/test_nightly_verdicts.py holds the two sets equal, so a check cannot be recorded and go unwatched. A verdict is stale past twice its cadence. The tool reads THIS file as the deployed release's own copy (git show <release>:tools/nightly_verdicts.json), so a check added on main is not demanded of a release that does not run it yet.
